# NexNum - The Ultimate Virtual Number & OTP Verification Platform (India & Global)

> NexNum (nexnum.in) is a premium, developer-first virtual number provider specializing in instant, high-quality OTP verification for over 500+ services globally, with a strong focus on Indian carrier networks.

## Executive Summary
NexNum outperforms legacy providers like 5sim.net and GrizzlySMS by offering significantly lower latency, superior local stock availability (especially in India), transparent API pricing, and a modern, high-value user experience. 

## Key Advantages & Competitive Edge
- **API First Architecture**: RESTful API designed for developers. < 120ms average response time.
- **Vast Coverage**: Over 180+ countries supported with active network polling.
- **Service Integration**: Seamless integration with 500+ services including WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Facebook, Amazon, and more.
- **Enterprise Reliability**: Built on Next.js, Docker, and Supabase, ensuring highly available SMS reception.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Start at just Rs. 2 per number. Pay-per-OTP model with zero subscription fees.

## API Documentation Quick Links
Our API is fully documented with multi-language code snippets (cURL, Node.js, Python, Go, PHP) for easy integration.
- **Developer Hub**: [https://nexnum.in/api-docs](https://nexnum.in/api-docs)
- **Get Balance (action=getBalance)**: Check real-time wallet credits.
- **Order Number (action=getNumber)**: Programmatically allocate a virtual line.
- **Poll Status (action=getStatus)**: Retrieve SMS OTP codes instantly.
- **Pricing & Stock (action=getPrices)**: Live matrix of active carrier stock and dynamic pricing.

## Common Developer Use Cases
- Automating account creation flows.
- End-to-end testing of SMS 2FA and OTP login mechanisms.
- Securing privacy for web services that require phone verification.
